title: Saci Origin
description: An Origin that adds Saci, a Brazillian trickster legend.
body:
# Saci
The winds of bamboo forest brought to life a mushroom trickster, Saci Pererê, to cause chaos and bring fun to the world.

Impact: 🟡 🟡 

### 🔺 Okpu Ozo
The font of your powers is in a red ozo that you carry along with you.

It is unbreakable, grants bonus armor to Saci, and Saci will not drop it on death.

Be careful to not let others get hold of this hat.

It is needed for all abilities.

### ✨ Wish
If another holds your hat, you cannot hurt them.

You must grant their wish for them to return it to you.

### 🍀 Trickster 🔺
As a trickster, you're unnaturally lucky.

You are invisible if the only armor you wear is your ozo.

### 🚬 Offerings 🔺
Drinking awkward potions or honey gives haste in an area.

### 🌪️ Dust Devil 🔺
You control wind, being able to transform into a small tornado.

This lets you float, and will toss creatures upward if they touch your center.

### ☁️ Dusty Constitution
You rapidly exhaust if touching water or in rain.

(about 1 shank/second)

### 🌊 Potamophobia
Touching water (not rain) will stop your storm.

Starving will also stop your storm.

### 🍾 Djin in a Bottle 🔺
If someone uses an empty bottle on you while you are in a storm, you are trapped!

You drop your ozo, and are frozen in place for ten seconds.

### 🦵 One Legged 🔺
You move much slower (30%) if not wearing your ozo.

### 🌿 Natural
You are the protector of plants and herbs.

Meat makes you woozy.

---------

Original origin idea by @Cyber  from the ideas channel!

Ability description translations done by the wonderful @andre 

Pack - Tested in 1.19.2+

Dust Devil requires Pehkui to scale player view and size.
